name: io.github.wtznicy/my-websearch
description: MyWebSearch - multi-engine web search MCP server, CLI and local daemon. No API keys required.

environmentVariables.name: EXA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Exa API key (https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys) — only needed for the exa search engine

environmentVariables.name: BRAVE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Brave Search API key (https://api.search.brave.com/app/keys) — for high-reliability official Brave Search API access

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional GitHub Personal Access Token (https://github.com/settings/tokens) — increases rate limit from 10/min to 30/min

environmentVariables.name: STACKOVERFLOW_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Stack Apps Key (https://stackapps.com/apps/oauth/register) — increases quota from 300/day to 10,000/day
